$description: Beat the Chill design tokens. Edit this file, then run `npm run build:tokens` to regenerate assets/css/tokens.css. Each top-level group becomes a block of CSS custom properties; the token key is the variable name (e.g. color.primary -> --primary). Reference another token with {group.key}.

color.$description: Primitive palette. Numbered suffixes are tints/shades of the base hue.

secondary.$description: Pine green. Touch pad buttons, loading bar.

scene-bg.$description: Page background behind the WebGL canvas (matches midnight fog).

semantic.$description: Role-based aliases. Components should use these rather than primitives where a role exists.

typography.$description: Inter is loaded from Google Fonts in each HTML page.

asset.$description: Image tokens. Paths are relative to assets/css/ (where tokens.css lives) and are wrapped in url() on build.

curl-img.$description: Corner curl shown on CTA hover/focus/active.

ornament.$description: Default panel corner ornament size and offset (large panels, overlays).

ornament-small.$description: Small ornament variant, e.g. the win bar.

ornament-hud.$description: HUD ornament variant for the timer and wood counter.
